sources.verified_fact: The official page lists June 2026 Ambulance Systems Indicators published on 9 July 2026 and splits systems and clinical indicators across England's 11 ambulance services. Revised monthly files are withdrawn and revisions are consolidated in the time-series and CSV products.
sources.quality_effect: Adds emergency-response service context while retaining call-versus-incident, response-category, trust geography, clinical-outcome lag and revision-policy guards; ambulance indicators are not parcel-level safety measurements.

sources.verified_fact: The page provides June 2026 Category 2 response-time data by Integrated Care Board and ambulance handover data by NHS trust, published on 9 July 2026. NHS England classifies these files as management information because they are collected with a tight turnaround.
sources.quality_effect: Adds local operational crosschecks while retaining management-information status, ICB-versus-trust geography, handover-definition, tight-turnaround and revision guards.

sources.source: A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions 2026-27, June 2026
sources.verified_fact: The June 2026 official release was published on 9 July 2026 and covers all A&E types, four-hour disposition, emergency admissions and waits after a decision to admit, with provider and system breakdowns. The accompanying ECDS products are provisional and have different coverage from the official monthly return.
sources.quality_effect: Adds urgent-care pressure context while retaining attendance-versus-person, A&E-type, admission, provider-footprint, provisional-ECDS and historical-estimation guards.

sources.verified_fact: The January-to-March 2026 publication reports about 799,000 incident records with a service area and 5,069 records missing that field. A record can contain multiple service-area responses and therefore be counted more than once; ambulance-trust recording rates ranged from 84 to 777 incidents per 100,000 contacts.
sources.quality_effect: Adds safety-reporting context while retaining record-versus-event, multi-response double-counting, missing-field, reporting-culture, denominator and trust-comparability guards.

sources.verified_fact: The FSA reports 2,073 food and feed safety incident notifications in 2025/26, 14% more than the previous year; 54 outbreaks or clusters of interest; and 12,700 signals that generated 51 new incident or product referrals requiring action. A new recording system permits multiple hazard categories and changed some apparent trends.
sources.quality_effect: Adds food-system resilience context while retaining notification-versus-confirmed-event, testing and reporting change, multi-hazard classification, outbreak-versus-cluster and cross-border-supply-chain guards.

sources.verified_fact: The dataset was updated on 6 July 2026 and contains substantiated, completed and closed Environment Agency incidents with a category 1 major or category 2 significant impact to water, land or air. It is a quarterly snapshot with investigation and recording lag and may change after quality assurance.
sources.quality_effect: Adds severe-environmental-incident context while retaining closed-record, impact-category, media, investigation-lag, QA-revision and no-owner-responsibility-inference guards.

sources.source: Environment Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 9 July 2026 annual report covers the Environment Agency's performance report, environmental performance measures, accountability and financial statements for April 2025 to March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds governance and response-capacity context while retaining KPI-versus-incident, reporting-year, target-definition and corporate-report-versus-official-statistics guards.

sources.verified_fact: For September 2024 to August 2025, NCSC received 1,727 incident tips, handled 429 incidents, classified 204 as nationally significant and 18 as highly significant. NCSC states that reporting is not mandatory for many businesses and the data are not a true measure of all UK cyber incidents.
sources.quality_effect: Adds cyber-response severity context while retaining tip-versus-incident, triage, support-threshold, classification, voluntary-reporting and non-prevalence guards.

sources.source: NCSC Annual Review 2025: Active Cyber Defence
sources.verified_fact: NCSC reports removal of 1.2 million cyber-enabled commodity campaigns and disruption of more than 26,000 phishing campaigns targeting government departments; 79% of confirmed HMG phishing attacks were resolved within 24 hours and half within one hour.
sources.quality_effect: Adds prevention-service context while retaining campaign-versus-domain, detection, confirmation, target-population, service-coverage and activity-versus-underlying-attack-volume guards.

sources.verified_fact: The 21 May 2026 report combines multiple Ofcom research programmes to monitor children's use of online services and exposure to harmful content before and after children's safety duties came into force.
sources.quality_effect: Adds online-safety monitoring context while retaining survey-versus-passive-measurement, age, platform, self-report, coverage, repeated-sample and pre/post-without-causal-attribution guards.

sources.source: Search and rescue helicopter statistics: year ending March 2025
sources.authority: Department for Transport and Maritime and Coastguard Agency
sources.verified_fact: The accredited release reports 2,849 civilian search-and-rescue helicopter taskings, 1,342 people rescued and 264 assisted, with taskings 4% above the previous year. Separate helicopters from different bases responding to one emergency are counted separately and stood-down taskings are included.
sources.quality_effect: Adds rescue-demand context while retaining tasking-versus-emergency, multi-base, stood-down, rescued-versus-assisted, land/coast/maritime and operational-coverage guards.

sources.source: MCA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published 15 July 2026 covers MCA activities, strategy, achievements, key performance indicators, governance and accounts for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds maritime-response governance context while retaining KPI-versus-incident, financial-year, service-output and corporate-report-versus-accident-statistics guards.

sources.verified_fact: The UKHSA collection, updated 25 June 2026, brings together routine microbiological and epidemiological infection reports, Environmental Health Protection Surveillance System reports and health-protection news.
sources.quality_effect: Adds authoritative surveillance-source routing while retaining scheme, pathogen, laboratory-confirmation, reporting-period, geography and bulletin-versus-incident guards.

sources.source: HPR volume 20 issue 5: STI and gastrointestinal infection updates
sources.verified_fact: UKHSA reports overall STI diagnoses down 8.3% between 2024 and 2025, while infectious syphilis diagnoses in heterosexual women rose 4.8%. Non-typhoidal salmonella reached 10,406 laboratory-confirmed cases in 2025, the highest level in a decade, while cryptosporidium cases fell 27.2%.
sources.quality_effect: Adds infectious-disease trend context while retaining diagnosis-versus-infection, testing, laboratory-confirmation, demographic subgroup, reporting geography and year-on-year-comparability guards.

sources.source: Annual assessment of National Highways performance: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: ORR reports that casualty rates per mile travelled on England's strategic road network remained at their lowest recorded level excluding 2020, and that killed-or-seriously-injured casualties were 38% below the 2005-to-2009 baseline. It also states that the 50% reduction target for the end of 2025 was almost certainly missed.
sources.quality_effect: Adds strategic-road safety performance context while retaining network-only scope, KSI definition, baseline, vehicle-mile exposure, reporting lag and target-versus-observed-outcome guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Ambulance quality, management information and A&E products use different status, coverage and geography.
Patient safety records can contain multiple service areas and reflect reporting behaviour as well as harm.
Food incidents, outbreaks, clusters, signals and hazard categories are distinct operational units.
Pollution data include only substantiated closed category 1 and 2 records and have investigation lag.
Corporate annual reports and KPIs are governance evidence, not incident prevalence statistics.
NCSC tips, handled incidents, significance classifications and takedown campaigns are separate measures and under-reporting is material.
Ofcom's pre/post monitoring does not by itself establish effects caused by online-safety duties.
Search-and-rescue taskings can include stood-down responses and multiple helicopters for one emergency.
Health-protection diagnoses and laboratory-confirmed reports depend on testing, reporting and surveillance definitions.
Strategic-road KSI measures cover the SRN and require baseline and vehicle-mile exposure context.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
